data.title: Amended 2022 Income Tax Assessment (Geänderter Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf amended the 2022 income tax assessment under § 175 AO because of a corrected notification from the employer. The income tax remains set at €6,918.00 (unchanged from before), so there is no additional payment or refund.
data.explanation: This letter replaces the earlier tax assessment of 14 June 2023 for the year 2022, but the tax amount itself did not change, so nothing is owed and nothing will be refunded. If you disagree with this assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt within the one-month period; the app will show you the exact deadline. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final as issued. No payment is required in either case.
